test_cases.name: creates_new_task_set
test_cases.input: Tạo task set mới trong .tasks để setup CI
assertions: Runs ls .tasks and uses the next free NN; gets the date from `date +%F`
Builds 00_tasks.json from templates/task-set.json and blocks in templates/tasks/, keeping each block's skills value
Verifies every path named in a prompt exists before writing it
Ends the set with the verify block as the last task
Leaves no {{placeholder}} or T0NN in the file
Writes AGENTS.md via scripts/check_task_set.py --fix and the validator then prints OK
Does NOT create a 01_status.json file

test_cases.name: add_subtask_with_progress
test_cases.input: Thêm subtask T002.4 vào task set đã có T001 done và T002 in_progress
assertions: Does NOT rewrite the whole 00_tasks.json
Adds only T002.4 and leaves every other task, status and note untouched
Refreshes the AGENTS.md table

test_cases.name: records_result_in_note
test_cases.input: Xong subtask T001.2, cập nhật task
assertions: Sets status to done only after checking expect
Writes the result (what was done, evidence) into that subtask's note
Edits only that subtask

test_cases.name: failed_needs_reason
assertions: Sets status to failed, never leaves in_progress and never sets done
Writes the reason into note and asks the user before continuing

test_cases.name: task_done_needs_all_subtasks
test_cases.input: Đánh dấu T002 done khi T002.3 còn pending
assertions: Refuses to set the task done while a subtask is not done or skipped

test_cases.name: no_waves
test_cases.input: Thêm wave WAVE_02 vào task set
assertions: States waves are not used and models the work as a task with subtasks instead

test_cases.name: validator_catches_drift
test_cases.input: Sửa tay bảng Current State trong AGENTS.md của một task set
assertions: Refuses to hand-edit the table and runs scripts/check_task_set.py --fix instead
Rows are ordered task row followed by its subtask rows

test_cases.name: task_has_subtasks_or_own_prompt
test_cases.input: Thêm prompt và expect trực tiếp vào task T002 đang có subtasks
assertions: Does NOT give a task both subtasks and its own prompt/expect
Puts the new step in a subtask instead
